operational_rationale: To safely learn how to use Notepad++ by exploring its useful capabilities and understanding how to enter text into the document buffer.
hypothesis: Typing alphanumeric text into the focused window will insert content and update buffer length

operational_rationale: To safely learn how to use Notepad++ and select all text without modal interruption.
hypothesis: Sending shortcut Ctrl+A will select buffer text without modal interruption

operational_rationale: To safely learn how to use Notepad++ and explore its useful capabilities, we need to experiment with creating a new tab/document buffer. This will help us understand the process and ensure that we can perform normal text-editing tasks without being told the interface.
hypothesis: Sending navigation shortcut Ctrl+N will instantiate a new document buffer tab

operational_rationale: To safely learn how to use Notepad++ by exploring its useful capabilities and understanding how to invoke the text search/find surface.
hypothesis: Sending shortcut Ctrl+F will open the Find dialog surface

operational_rationale: To safely learn how to use Notepad++ by exploring its useful capabilities and testing the bounds of invalid UI toolbar button probes.
hypothesis: Clicking an invalid unmapped button target will result in no state transition
